# REL-63: AI made visible: how each explanation was produced

Status: **Done** | Phase 5 - Showcase polish | Owner: Claude | issue #403

## Outcome

For every explained failure, the console shows what the AI saw, what it answered, how long it took and whether the rules check agreed

## Depends on

- [REL-62](REL-62.md) Phase 5 decisions and three console design directions - Done

## Unblocks

- [REL-65](REL-65.md) Console redesign in the chosen direction with the money-saved headline

## Acceptance

- [x] Each stored explanation records how long generation took (`generation_ms`), the model's named cause and the rules cause, and the inputs the model was given (the same facts the prompt uses: status, reason codes, timeline; never the payment description, ADR-0012); a migration adds the columns, existing rows read as unknown
- [x] `GET /payments/{id}/explanation` returns them, plus a `cross_check` verdict (`agreed`, `disagreed_rules_used` or `rules_only`); the API contract, the generated reference and the guides are updated
- [x] The payment page shows a panel 'How the AI explained this': model name and that it runs locally, inputs shown, answer, time taken, and the cross-check verdict in words; a rules-only explanation says so plainly
- [x] Tests: storage and API fields, the description never appears in stored inputs or the response, the panel in every source and verdict case (Vitest) and in the e2e suite with the model unreachable

## Steps

1. **REL-63.1 Write failing tests** (done) - Fields, the description guard, and the panel cases.
